settings.title: Azure CMK Security Architecture
settings.subtitle: Server-Side Encryption with Customer-Managed Keys
settings.content:
### End-to-End Cryptographic Flow
```text
[Azure Key Vault: kvcmk17476]
       |
       | (RSA 2048-bit Key: disk-encryption-key)
       v
[Disk Encryption Set: des-disk-cmk]
       |
       | (System-Assigned Managed Identity)
       v
[Managed OS Disk: vm-encrypted]
```
* **Encryption Standard**: Hardware-accelerated AES-256 Envelope Encryption
* **Key Rotation**: Automatic Zero-Downtime Key Synchronization
* **Access Model**: Role `Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User`
* **Resilience**: Purge Protection & Soft Delete Enabled

settings.title: Security Experiments & Audit Trail
settings.subtitle: Key Lifecycle & Azure Monitor Logs
settings.content:
### Security Experiments Conducted
* **Experiment A (Key Rotation):** Rotated to Key `v2`; DES synced automatically without VM reboot.
* **Experiment B (Access Revocation):** Disabled CMK; VM restart was blocked, preventing unauthorized access. Re-enabling restored VM.

### Non-Repudiation Audit Trail
* `Deallocate VM` -> **Started**
* `Update Key Vault` -> **Succeeded**
* `Create Virtual Machine` -> **Succeeded**
* `Create or Update Disk` -> **Accepted**
